confidentUnsupported.evidence: 'Yes, it was almost certainly a transient glitch. These codes can sometimes appear due to minor voltage fluctuations or momentary sensor communication hiccups'

rationale: The assistant's power-cycle advice cleared the fault and it correctly recommended no part and no escalation, so the homeowner ends with a working oven. However it misidentified E011 as a temperature sensor/PCB fault (an explicitly unsupported claim) and never asked whether the touch panel was wet, obstructed or recently cleaned, so it missed the real cause. The closing 'almost certainly a transient glitch' due to 'voltage fluctuations' is confident and wrong, leaving the customer without the key advice to keep the panel dry, making recurrence likely.
